content.headline: Seekh Kebab Naan Roll
content.body: A handheld idea using items already on your menu.

idea.name: Seekh Kebab Naan Roll
ingredients: seekh kebab (minced lamb with fresh herbs and green chilli)
mint yoghurt (as served with the Chicken Tikka Wrap)
pickled onions (as served with the Chicken Tikka Wrap)
steps: Spread mint yoghurt over the naan and lay the kebabs on top.
Add pickled onions, roll up tightly and cut in half to serve.

content.headline: Tikka Masala Chips Bowl
content.body: A warming, loaded bowl made only from ingredients already on our menu.

idea.name: Tikka Masala Chips Bowl
ingredients: chicken tikka (boneless chicken thigh in house yoghurt marinade)
steps: Fry and season the masala chips as usual.
Grill the chicken tikka, then cut into bite-sized pieces.
Pile the chips into a bowl and top with the chicken tikka.
Drizzle with mint yoghurt and finish with pickled onions.
idea.why_now: It is a comforting, easy-to-make bowl that uses ingredients the kitchen already has on the menu.
